title: EvidenceIndex
description: Lean deterministic address layer over the three candidate factual authorities (DEC-14, DEC-34, Contract 11.1). Permitted purposes: source navigation, reference-existence checks, integrity/provenance coordinates and optional source-stated markers. It must not rank, score, summarize, infer fit, infer truth, become a factual carrier, or assert an exhaustive byte partition. Direct source access remains unconditional even where a passage has no granular entry.

partition_claim.description: Explicitly present and false. No byte-partition theorem is asserted and no partition test exists (DEC-34).

sources.description: Exactly the three factual authorities (INV-03). The generator reads nothing else for factual entries.

evidence_id.$comment: Namespace marker EV: keeps factual references visibly distinct from mechanical baseline references BL: (DEC-34, ACC-08).

kind.description: FILE is the mandatory per-authority root entry. PREAMBLE is the optional convenience entry for text before the first heading; it exists so a preamble-bearing source still indexes usably without any partition claim (Contract 11.1, test 12).

heading_path.description: Heading ancestry in document order. Empty for FILE and PREAMBLE entries.

content_sha256.description: Deterministic integrity coordinate for the addressed span.

source_stated_ids.description: Identifiers the source itself writes in this span, copied literally (for example CLM-BAR-001, EDU-002, PRJ-03). Never inferred, never invented, never ranked. These are navigation aids, not a second reference namespace.
